note: Diagrams from Wikimedia Commons, stored locally. tools/fetch_commons.py fills licence, author, file and sha256 from the Commons API and refuses any licence not in the allowlist. Only entries with decision 'accepted' and a verified licence are shown; every other slot keeps its drawing from src/art.js. Shown diagrams are clinical content: they are hashed into the 'illustrations' review item by tests/release_gate.mjs. Items with origin "generated" are AI-generated pictures supplied by the site owner; they carry no licence check and are not clinical evidence.
